purpose: Make every Graham fair explanation a generated view of the governed arithmetic so explanatory text cannot drift from the authoritative exact and displayed fair.

adjustmentClassification.otherGovernedRule: Every numeric pointsToHomeSpread adjustment not classified as home field, personnel, or matchup contributes to otherGovernedPointsToHomeSpread.

arithmetic.formula: neutralTeamBaseHome + homeFieldPointsToHomeSpread + personnelPointsToHomeSpread + matchupPointsToHomeSpread + otherGovernedPointsToHomeSpread = exactFairHome

productionRule: Any governed production workflow that changes an active Graham fair must synchronize and validate the fair decomposition before publishing current-numbers.json.
